paper_title: DART Distilling Autoregressive Reasoning to Silent Thought
caption: Accuracy and inference time on GSM8K with varying C, the number of ST tokens.
model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the relationship between accuracy and inference time on the GSM8K dataset as the number of ST tokens, denoted as C, varies from 0 to 30. The x-axis is labeled "ST Token Number C" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 30, with tick marks at regular intervals of 5. The y-axis is dual-axis: the left y-axis, labeled "Accuracy (%)", ranges from 36% to 43% with tick marks at 1% intervals, while the right y-axis, labeled "Inference time (ms)", ranges from 33 ms to 40 ms with tick marks at 1 ms intervals. The blue line with circular markers represents accuracy, starting at 37% at C=0, rising to 42% at C=5, declining to 41% at C=10, peaking at 42.5% at C=20, and settling at 42% at C=30. The red line with square markers represents inference time, starting at approximately 39 ms at C=0, rising to approximately 39.5 ms at C=5, remaining relatively stable around 39 ms until C=10, then increasing gradually to approximately 39.5 ms at C=20, and finally reaching approximately 39.5 ms at C=30.
